evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/f/c consists of a dense catalog of S2C opcode constants whose values match independently recovered incoming contracts, including 219 CLOSE_INTERFACES, 27 OPEN_AMOUNT_INPUT_PROMPT, 50 FRIEND_STATUS_UPDATE, 44 GROUND_ITEM_SPAWN, 117 PROJECTILE and 241 CONSTRUCTED_REGION_CHANGE.

The class initializes one 256-entry int array indexed by raw incoming opcode. Fixed packets receive their exact byte lengths while variable-byte and variable-short packets receive -1 and -2 sentinels respectively.
Representative entries match the exact-current protocol corpus and the live R342 IncomingPacketLengthTable framing values: opcode 34=-2, 53=-2, 81=-2, 126=-2, 196=-1, 214=-2, 241=-2 and 253=-1.

R342 rs/f/d is the separate live IncomingPacketLengthTable consumed directly by Client framing. rs/f/c instead packages the raw incoming opcode constants together with their canonical raw length definitions, so the proposed name stops at Definitions rather than Parser or Dispatcher.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the static incoming/server packet opcode-and-length definition catalog. No individual field names are proposed in this class-only batch.
